# Vertical Plan Traceability

Vertical business-slice tasks with source anchors and explicit contract checkpoints keep a brownfield rewrite independently executable while preserving frozen routes.

## What Happened
For BottleBazaar t7, the architecture defined nine units but the project profile explicitly
said grouping was not needed. The plan therefore used setup/foundation, customer P1 slices,
merchant/admin slices, and final gates rather than technical-layer tasks.

## Takeaway
When no topology groups exist, retain vertical phase labels and map every task to a numbered
plan item and every requirement to implementation evidence. Put source annotations only on
rewrite tasks; keep setup/config tasks free of invented source anchors.

## History
- 2026-10-25 (BottleBazaar/t7): initial
- 2026-10-25 (BottleBazaar/t9): planning checkpoints were strengthened with explicit
  validation counts and the authoritative `artifacts/plan.md` path.
